ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Who is a predator of shellfish?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web image shows the label "Shellfish" at the bottom left and the label "Birds" near the top center. An arrow goes from the shellfish group upward toward Birds. Reasoning: In this food web, arrows point from the food or prey to the organism that eats it. Since Birds receive an arrow from shellfish, Birds are a predator of shellfish.
